workspace_local_reply: A useful next step is to connect this question to an experiment and define what evidence would change the current design.
workspace_initial_question: Find concepts like this that work in comparable European cities.
workspace_initial_reply: Scout found a potential local gap: no dedicated herbal pharmacy in the current Rhine-Main results. Existing alternatives cover parts of the concept. Verify those alternatives locally, then test whether customers care enough to switch and pay.

workspace_filter_note: Refine the scouting criteria. This reference shortlist is not updated by a live search.
workspace_reference_note: Five reference businesses. Descriptions and comparison values are illustrative and should be verified before making a decision.
workspace_benchmark_0: Specialist herb drugstore selling loose medicinal herbs, teas and its own blends, with in-store advice and an online shop.
workspace_benchmark_1: Viennese maker of medicinal teas and herbal remedies, sold through pharmacies and its own channels.
workspace_benchmark_2: Pharmacy specialised in herbal medicine that mixes individual herb blends next to the regular pharmacy offer.
workspace_benchmark_3: Online herbal store with dried herbs, herbal blends and natural supplements, shipped nationwide.
workspace_benchmark_4: Smartshop with a large online range of medicinal herbs sold by weight, next to teas and extracts.
workspace_gap_title: No dedicated herbal pharmacy found in the current Scout results.
workspace_gap_text: Existing alternatives cover parts of the concept, but not the full combination of specialist herbal expertise, custom blends and pharmacist advice.
workspace_comparison_note: Illustrative coverage: ● full · ◐ half · ◔ quarter · ○ none. These are reference judgements, not measured scores.
workspace_next_step: Turn the opportunity into a question →
workspace_prompt_reply: The reference shortlist points to a potential local gap. Compare what existing alternatives already cover, verify the gap locally and test whether customers value specialist advice and custom blends enough to switch.
workspace_idea_title: A current concept, open to change
workspace_idea_copy: A specialist pharmacy for medicinal herbs, custom blends and expert advice in Rhine-Main. Traditional remedies form the starting point; any expanded range depends on a product-specific regulatory and licensing review.
workspace_idea_next: Explore alternatives, then test why people would choose this pharmacy.
workspace_hypotheses_intro: Four working assumptions drawn from the validation pathway. Priorities remain open to review; illustrative results do not validate an assumption.
workspace_hyp_0: The intended range can be offered within a viable licensing model.
workspace_why_0: This determines which offering can exist at all. Illustrative clearance counts do not establish actual permission.
workspace_hyp_1: Customers will switch from existing sources at the intended price.
workspace_why_1: Interest alone does not show willingness to change buying behaviour or pay.
workspace_hyp_2: A local counter can generate sufficient paying transactions.
workspace_why_2: The pop-up result is pending. A regional gap is not evidence of demand.
workspace_hyp_3: Transactions can contribute enough to cover operating costs.
workspace_why_3: Rent, staff, stock and billing costs can change whether the concept is viable.
workspace_experiments_intro: Open any module to review its questions, methods and evidence. A completed programme phase is not proof that its assumptions hold.
workspace_learnings_intro: Read the early signals, distinguish what remains unresolved and decide what to test or revisit next.
workspace_support_note: What currently supports the idea? The illustrative demand, concept and advice signals are above their example benchmarks. They suggest testing the combined offer locally; they do not yet establish paying demand.
workspace_contradict_note: None recorded. This does not mean that no contradiction exists; collect customer objections and alternative explanations.
workspace_implications_copy: Do not commit to a permanent location yet. Local paying demand, pop-up conversion and unit economics remain unresolved. Continue validating demand and economics, and use those results to revisit the customer, offering and location decisions.
workspace_design_intro: What we currently believe the business could be. Validation can change this draft; a design change creates new questions to test.
workspace_customer_current: Health-conscious Rhine-Main residents seeking herbal remedies and personal advice.
workspace_customer_assumption: The priority segment and its willingness to switch are not established.
workspace_problem_current: Access to specialist advice and tailored herbal blends in one local place.
workspace_problem_assumption: We still need to understand how customers solve this today and what is missing.
workspace_value_current: Medicinal herbs, individual blends and knowledgeable advice together.
workspace_value_assumption: Advice must create enough value to change purchase behaviour.
workspace_offering_current: Traditional herbal remedies and consultations; an expanded range remains conditional on regulatory review.
workspace_offering_assumption: The permitted range, licensing and reliable supply are unresolved.
workspace_market_current: Rhine-Main as the initial catchment, with European reference formats to investigate.
workspace_market_assumption: The potential gap in specialist retail has not been verified locally.
workspace_gtm_current: Data driven PR, digital communications and events to drive customers to store. A landing-page and pop-up counter test whether those channels bring local customers who act on the offer.
workspace_gtm_assumption: Acquisition channels and conversion at the required daily rate remain open.
workspace_economics_current: A working economic model for transaction contribution, rent, staff, stock, licensing and billing costs. Test the key financial drivers against traffic, cost and revenue benchmarks.
workspace_economics_assumption: No verified unit economics or financial forecast is available.
workspace_model_current: A specialist retail pharmacy with advice. Reimbursed and out-of-pocket purchases need separate consideration.
workspace_model_assumption: The reimbursement mix and cost of administering claims remain assumptions.
workspace_ask_design: Which evidence would change this design?

library_herbal_concept: A specialist pharmacy for medicinal herbs: loose herbs, custom blends and expert advice in one shop. The business model can be varied to include Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), Ayurveda, ancestral and legal psychedelic plants, or in-store treatments.
workspace_financing_loop: Validation and Business Design inform the financing case. Revisit either as new questions arise.
financing_intro: Use validation results and the current business design to build investor confidence.
financing_validation_copy: Build the business and validation case: what customers need, why this offer matters, what has been tested and what remains unresolved.
financing_validation_note: The current demand, concept and advice results are illustrative. Local paying demand and economics still need evidence before they can support an investment decision.
financing_financial_copy: Bring the economic model, investment needed and financial projections together. Show the assumptions behind costs, revenue and the funding requirement.
financing_financial_note: These are draft opportunity estimates. Financial experiments remain in Validation; the current economic model belongs in Business Design → Economics.
financing_package_copy: Prepare the business concept, validation case and financial material for investor review. Keep assumptions and unresolved results visible.
financing_package_note: Working material · documents are not yet available for download.
financing_conversations_copy: Discuss the case with interested investors and use their questions to strengthen the business and validation case.
financing_no_conversations: No investor conversations recorded. Interested investor details are still to follow.
financing_close_copy: Negotiate with investors based on your validation results. Agree the investment, terms and conditions needed to launch the business.
financing_close_note: Financing pending. No investors, offers or agreed terms are recorded.
financing_question: What must the case demonstrate before approaching investors?
financing_reply: Connect the validation case with the economic model. Separate illustrative signals from verified results, and identify the local demand and financial evidence still needed before an investor conversation.
programme_financials_copy: Test key financial drivers against real data.
programme_pilot_copy: As a market stand, a pop-up or a dummy website.
